response.query: What system-identification procedure will we use and how many real trajectories per robot are planned to tighten domain-randomization priors before adaptation?
response.answer: We will use a system-identification procedure based on domain randomization. We plan to collect 50 real trajectories per robot to tighten priors before adaptation.
